+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '8580'
+title: Decide and fix the CLI mail-drain time limit (CLIMailWait.timeLimit)
+---
+## What
+**Blocked on a decision of the user. An agent must not select the option.**
+
+`CLIMailWait.demo` (`Sources/MultitoolCLI/CLIAnswerDrain.swift:59-61`) sets the drain `timeLimit` to the static `MultiToolConfiguration.defaultExecutionTimeLimit` (120 s). The drain arms it after the first answer (`CLIAnswerDrain.swift:500`). When it fires, the CLI prints "The session did not become idle in …" and cancels the session (`:522-523`).
+
+Conflict: this is a second clock with the same value as the `runCode` tool timeout. A snippet that runs to its limit settles near 120 s into the drain. Then the drain cancels the session before the mail answer can come. It also reads the static default, not the instance config.
+
+Options:
+- **A. Remove `timeLimit`.** The drain waits for the open runs and the quiet period only. Each `runCode` run is bounded by its own tool timeout. Risk: a `shell.execute` with no `timeout` argument has no bound by design (`Sources/FoundationModelsMultitool/Capabilities/Shell/Execute.swift:132-139`), so the CLI can wait forever on it.
+- **B. Keep a host bound, not tied to `runCode`.** Make it a CLI argument or a separate constant that is clearly a process-lifetime limit, longer than any tool timeout. Read the instance config if it stays related.
+
+After the decision, the subtasks are:
+- [ ] Change `CLIMailWait` in `Sources/MultitoolCLI/CLIAnswerDrain.swift` (and its use at `Sources/MultitoolCLI/CLIRunner.swift:1122-1123`) per the decision.
+- [ ] Update or remove `openRunStopsAtTheTimeLimit` in `Tests/FoundationModelsMultitoolTests/CLIAnswerDrainTests.swift:296` and the helper `gatedMailWait(on:timeLimit:)`.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] The CLI drain never cancels the session while a `runCode` mail answer is still due inside the `runCode` tool timeout.
+- [ ] `CLIMailWait` does not read `MultiToolConfiguration.defaultExecutionTimeLimit`.
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] A test in `Tests/FoundationModelsMultitoolTests/CLIAnswerDrainTests.swift` with `GatedClock`: a run that settles at the `runCode` limit still prints its mail answer before exit.
+- [ ] `swift test --filter CLIAnswerDrainTests` passes. `swift test` passes.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass. #timeouts #stuck
\ No newline at end of file
